rv.q: What the play explores so effectively, with dazzling wit and piercing insight into alpha male psychology, is how the three friends and colleagues continually self-sabotage their chances in a decades-long three-way game of Prisoner’s Dilemma .
But presenting all three as unremitting backstabbing bastards does make it difficult to care about them.

cn.t: This witty, cerebral political drama about Labour heavyweights Jenkins, Healey, and Crosland earns praise for beautiful writing and strong performances that resonate across decades.
